title: allow a non-standard size render name such as VIEW-80x10.txt in the approval-card contract when the slice's acceptance size is not 80x24

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-222936-fc21, project ork, item S600:

allow a non-standard size render name such as VIEW-80x10.txt in the approval-card contract when the slice's acceptance size is not 80x24

Evidence: S600 acceptance is at 80x10 and the 80x24 fixture needed 30 goals before the lift showed the cue
